patches.value: M_R is the R-span of M inside V: its elements are finite sums of r m with r in R and m in M. The natural multiplication map R tensor_Z M -> V sends r tensor m to r m. The definition by the image does not assume injectivity of this map.
For i,j in I, E_ij is the unique complex-linear operator with E_ij e_j=e_i and E_ij e_k=0 for every k in I different from j, extended linearly using the complex basis e.
J={c in C : c v belongs to M_R}. No generator of J is selected in this definition.
